Reason for Mistake: The Planner mis-synthesized the correctly gathered data, stating that “The Newest Pledge has the director born earlier” while the earlier steps established that Jason Michael Brescia (The Newest Pledge) was born in 1986 and Oscar Barney Finn (Más allá de la aventura) was born in 1938.
